questions.question: Why did Paul Theroux choose to travel by train?

  • authentic experiences, and a slower pace for reflection - Theroux's childhood longing for
  • train travel, sparked by growing up near railroad tracks, symbolizes a lifelong passion for
  • exploration and discovery - nostalgia influences his approach to travel as an adventure
  • emphasizing the experience of the journey itself rather than the destination.
questions.final_answer: emphasizing the experience of the journey itself rather than the destination
